TV automation · one-time setup. In Chrome, install Tampermonkey, then update the TV helper. The helper opens individual settings and chooses “Respingeți toate” to reject optional Digi24 cookies, starts playback, and fits the video to this room. Allow userscripts in Chrome if prompted. Reload this page after installation, then select a channel. RD-S channels start in their new tabs with a player-only layout; browser fullscreen and sound may require one click. Press Esc to exit fullscreen.

A smoother next visit. This room remembers your last channel. Source websites control playback, cookies, ads and consent. If a source blocks embedded viewing, use “Open original”. Saving consent in your usual browser may reduce repeat prompts; this app cannot remove the source’s checks.
A small space for your everyday television.Nine channels. One room.

Install Scarlat TV

Android phones / Chrome: use Install app or Add to Home screen in the browser menu.

iPhone / iPad: use Share → Add to Home Screen.

Desktop: use the browser’s Install option; in Safari use File → Add to Dock.

Chromecast with Google TV: direct browser installation depends on the TV browser. If it has no Install option, use a bookmark or cast from a supported device. This PWA is not a native Google TV app.

This personal app requires an internet connection. Anyone with its address can open it. RD-S channels open in your browser; automation still requires a browser supporting the helper.
